verdict.summary: The change is documentation plus a non-vacuous regression tripwire for the existing scalar revocation-reference invariant. The implementation confirms that every scan-covering attestation is resolved against the single manifest.revocation value, so distinct issuer-signed status slots fail with RevocationReferenceMismatch. The new test reaches that comparison with independently valid attestations and includes a same-slot positive control, while the documentation consistently describes the limitation as fail-closed, unchanged, research-grade, and still externally unaudited under sq-qhy4. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect was found.
